module: Determines whether a vehicle model or configuration (.pc) is "shipped" with the game, i.e. not excluded by the deployment filter file /DevTools/deployfilters/shared_prepack.txt. The file is read once (lowercase rules, empty lines and # comments ignored), glob-style rules (*, **, ?) are converted to Lua patterns and results are cached. Used by the thumbnail creator (modelSelection, job) to photograph only shipped vehicles.
notes: A path is considered shipped by default; it stops being so as soon as a rule in the file matches it (exact prefix or glob pattern).

If the file /DevTools/deployfilters/shared_prepack.txt does not exist (the case for a normal game installation, this DevTools folder being an internal tool), no rule is loaded and everything is considered shipped.

isModelShipped.desc: Indicates whether the /vehicles/<model>/ folder is not excluded by the deployment filters.

returns.desc: true if the model is shipped.

isConfigShipped.desc: Indicates whether the model AND the file /vehicles/<model>/<config>.pc are shipped.

returns.desc: true if the config is shipped.

clearCache.desc: Forgets the loaded rules and the result cache; the filter file will be reread on the next call.
